author: FOX4
title: Dallas Police Release Details on Second in-Custody Death in 2025
text:
The Dallas Police Department has released an update on the death in custody that occurred on July 13, 2025. This is the second death in custody for the department in 2025. The incident involved a man named Jerrell Johnson who was taken into custody after a series of disturbances.
The Dallas Police Department provided an update on the death in custody that occurred on July 13, 2025, at 5600 Lemmon Avenue . This marks the second death in custody for the Dallas Police Department in 2025. According to the preliminary investigation, at approximately 3:49 p.m. on July 13, 2025, Dallas Police received a 911 call regarding 41-year-old Jerrell Johnson , who had entered a business in the 5600 block of Lemmon Avenue .
The Dallas Police stated that Johnson was causing a disturbance by acting erratically, wandering through the aisles, and spitting in a man's face before pushing past him as he exited the business. \Following this incident, Johnson walked next door to a convenience store, entering at approximately 3:51 p.m. He confronted the employees, demanding money. As the employees ran toward the back office attempting to close the door, Johnson forced it open and grabbed a female employee by the neck, pulling her back towards the cash register and forcing her to open it. He then took the money. The woman alleged she broke free and ran outside, where Johnson followed and continued to assault her. At this point, several witnesses intervened, separating the victim from Johnson until the police arrived. \The first officer arrived at approximately 3:55 p.m. and found Johnson lying on his back, sweating, and breathing heavily. The officer rolled Johnson onto his stomach to handcuff him, then turned him over and helped him sit up while collecting Johnson’s personal information. At approximately 4:01 p.m., Johnson attempted to lie back down and asked for water. At 4:05 p.m., the officer observed that Johnson was unable to sit up without help and called for an ambulance. Additional officers helped support Johnson while they awaited the arrival of medical personnel. Dallas Fire-Rescue’s Medic 1 Unit arrived at approximately 4:17 p.m. and checked Johnson’s blood pressure and oxygen levels. An ambulance arrived at 4:23 p.m., and Dallas Fire-Rescue began CPR at 4:31 p.m. Dallas Fire-Rescue transported Johnson to the hospital, where he died. The Dallas Police Department stated that no officers used force during this incident. This is an ongoing investigation being conducted by the Dallas Police Special Investigations Unit. The Dallas County District Attorney’s Office has been notified and will conduct their own investigation. The Office of Community Police Oversight was also notified, responded to the scene, and has been briefed. For transparency, the Dallas Police Department has released the 911 audio and body-worn camera footage of the incident
